name: 95340 · Merced, CA
findings: ZIP 95340 (Merced) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95340 (Merced) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95340 (Merced) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
